summary: End a Writable after an optional final chunk, preserving callback-before-finish ordering and return identity.

target.notes: Optionally write the final chunk, mark writableEnded, reject later writes, run finalization, invoke end callback before 'finish' (or on error), and return the same writable.

caveats: end() does not mean underlying resources are already closed; finish and close are distinct.
Pending buffered writes must be processed before finish.

tests.name: end callback before finish
tests.input: const {Writable}=require('node:stream'); const out=[]; const w=new Writable({write(c,e,cb){cb()}}); w.on('finish',()=>out.push('finish')); w.end('x',()=>out.push('callback')); process.nextTick(()=>console.log(out.join(',')));
